arxiv-1707-05881.title: On Thin Air Reads: Towards an Event Structures Model of Relaxed Memory
arxiv-1707-05881.creator: Alan Jeffrey, James Riely
arxiv-1707-05881.description: Abstract . To model relaxed memory, we propose confusion-free event structures over an alphabet with a justification relation. Executions are modeled by justified configurations, where every read event has a justifying write event. Justification alone is too weak a criterion, since it allows cycles of the kind that result in so-called thin-air reads.

arxiv-2108-07533.title: Investigating transformers in the decomposition of polygonal shapes as point collections
arxiv-2108-07533.creator: Andrea Alfieri, Yancong Lin, Jan C. van Gemert
arxiv-2108-07533.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrea Alfieri, Yancong Lin, Jan C. van Gemert. Transformers can generate predictions in two approaches: 1. auto-regressively by conditioning each sequence element on the previous ones, or 2. directly produce an output sequences in parallel.

arxiv-2203-11398.title: A Hybrid Lagrangian-Eulerian Model for the Structural Analysis of Multifield Datasets
arxiv-2203-11398.creator: Z. Ding 1 and X. M. Tricoche 1 1 Computer Science Department, Purdue University, USA
arxiv-2203-11398.description: Abstract Multifields datasets are common in a large number of research and engineering applications of computational science. The effective visualization of the corresponding datasets can facilitate their analysis by elucidating the complex and dynamic interactions that exist between the attributes that describe the physics of the phenomenon.

arxiv-2203-13442.title: Dualband and Tripleband Metamaterial absorber in WR1 band and Lower TeraHertz frequencies
arxiv-2203-13442.creator: Sarvesh Gharat, Prutha Kulkarni, Shriganesh Prabhu, Chandrashekhar Garde
arxiv-2203-13442.description: Abstract Frequency Band of 0.5 THz to 1.1 THz (WR1.5 and WR1) is one of the promising bands when it comes to 6G. In this paper, we propose a novel metamaterial absorber suitable to be used at lower WR1 frequencies in TE mode. Alternatively, the design can be used as a strong absorber at lower Terahertz frequencies.

arxiv-2207-02080.title: Adiabatic Quantum Zeno Dynamics of Bosonic Atom Pairs with Large Inelastic Losses
arxiv-2207-02080.creator: Manel Bosch Aguilera 1 , Alexis Ghermaoui 1 , Rémy Vatré 1 , Raphaël Bouganne 1 , Jérôme Beugnon 1 , Fabrice Gerbier 1
arxiv-2207-02080.description: Abstract We report on experiments exploring the non-Hermitian dynamics of pairs of two-level atoms tightly confined in an optical lattice and driven by a near-resonant laser. Although spontaneous emission is negligible for the long-lived excited state, two-body dissipation arises from strong inelastic collisions between two atoms in the excited state.

arxiv-2310-14020.title: Dimension Reduction for Positively Curved Steady Solitons
arxiv-2310-14020.creator: Pak-Yeung Chan, Zilu Ma, Yongjia Zhang
arxiv-2310-14020.description: Abstract We consider noncollapsed steady gradient Ricci solitons with nonnegative sectional curvature. We show that such solitons always dimension reduce at infinity. This generalizes an earlier result in [ CDM22 ] to higher dimensions. In dimension four, we classify possible reductions at infinity, which lays foundation for possible classifications of steady solitons.

arxiv-2312-02252.title: StoryGPT-V: Large Language Models as Consistent Story Visualizers
arxiv-2312-02252.creator: Xiaoqian Shen, Mohamed Elhoseiny
arxiv-2312-02252.description: Abstract Recent generative models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating realistic and visually pleasing images grounded on textual prompts. Nevertheless, a significant challenge remains in applying these models for the more intricate task of story visualization. Since it requires resolving pronouns (he, she, they) in the frame descriptions, i.e., anaphora resolution, and ensuring consistent characters and background synthesis across frames.

arxiv-2408-05329.title: Spin-Orbit Alignment of Early-type Astrometric Binaries and the Origin of Slow Rotators
arxiv-2408-05329.creator: Chase L. Smith, Maxwell Moe, and Kaitlin M. Kratter
arxiv-2408-05329.description: Abstract The spin-orbit alignment of binary stars traces their formation and accretion history. Previous studies of spin-orbit alignment have been limited to small samples, slowly rotating solar-type stars, and/or wide visual binaries that not surprisingly manifest random spin-orbit orientations. We analyze 917 Gaia astrometric binaries across periods P P = 100 - 3,000 days ( a a = 0.

arxiv-2412-07164.title: Order Polytopes of Dimension ≤ 13 \leq 13 are Ehrhart Positive
arxiv-2412-07164.creator: Feihu Liu, Guoce Xin, Zihao Zhang
arxiv-2412-07164.description: Abstract The order polytopes arising from the finite poset were first introduced and studied by Stanley. For any positive integer d ≥ 14 d\geq 14 , Liu and Tsuchiya proved that there exists a non-Ehrhart positive order polytope of dimension d d . They also proved that any order polytope of dimension d ≤ 11 d\leq 11 is Ehrhart positive.

arxiv-2412-10133.title: You Name It, I Run It: An LLM Agent to Execute Tests of Arbitrary Projects
arxiv-2412-10133.creator: Islem Bouzenia, Michael Pradel
arxiv-2412-10133.description: Abstract . The ability to execute the test suite of a project is essential in many scenarios, e.g., to assess code quality and code coverage, to validate code changes made by developers or automated tools, and to ensure compatibility with dependencies.

arxiv-2505-16471.title: Graph-Supported Dynamic Algorithm Configuration for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
arxiv-2505-16471.creator: Robbert Reijnen, Yaoxin Wu, Zaharah Bukhsh, Yingqian Zhang
arxiv-2505-16471.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has been widely used for dynamic algorithm configuration, particularly in evolutionary computation, which benefits from the adaptive update of parameters during the algorithmic execution. However, applying DRL to algorithm configuration for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO) problems remains relatively unexplored. This paper presents a novel graph neural network (GNN) based DRL to configure multi-objective evolutionary algorithms.

arxiv-2509-02584.description: Abstract 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 16W10; Secondary 16D25 Abstract: We introduced the class of weakly generalized p.q.-Baer * -rings. europmc-pmc5653668.title: High grade serous ovarian carcinomas originate in the fallopian tube.
europmc-pmc5653668.creator: Labidi-Galy SI, Papp E, Hallberg D, Niknafs N, Adleff V, Noe M, Bhattacharya R, Novak M, Jones S, Phallen J, Hruban CA, Hirsch MS, Lin DI, Schwartz L, Maire CL, Tille JC, Bowden M, Ayhan A, Wood LD, Scharpf RB, Kurman R, Wang TL, Shih IM, Karchin R, Drapkin R, Velculescu VE.
europmc-pmc5653668.description: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC) is the most frequent type of ovarian cancer and has a poor outcome. It has been proposed that fallopian tube cancers may be precursors of HGSOC but evolutionary evidence for this hypothesis has been limited. Here, we perform...

pmc-11608170.title: Retrieval of refractivity fields from GNSS tropospheric delays: theoretical and data-based evaluation of collocation methods and comparisons with GNSS tomography
pmc-11608170.creator: Endrit Shehaj, Alain Geiger, Markus Rothacher, Gregor Moeller
pmc-11608170.description: This paper focuses on the retrieval of refractivity fields from GNSS measurements by means of least-squares collocation. Collocation adjustment estimates parameters that relate delays and refractivity without relying on a grid. It contains functional and stochastic models that define the characteristics of the retrieved refractivity fields.

pmc-11631592.title: The burden of acute malnutrition among children under five in conflict-afflicted Gaza strip: prevalence and associated factors
pmc-11631592.creator: Ahmed Albelbeisi, Kate Zinszer, Abdel Hamid El Bilbeisi, Samer Abuzerr
pmc-11631592.description: BackgroundThis study aims to assess the prevalence and associated factors of Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) and Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM) among children in this region during a period of conflict.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted with a sample of 1,200 children under 5 years old, selected through stratified random sampling from three governorates in the Gaza Strip.

pmc-11644167.title: The Use of Terahertz Computed Tomography and Time Domain Spectroscopy to Evaluate Symmetry in 3D Printed Parts
pmc-11644167.creator: Dolores Termini, John Federici, Ian Gatley, Louis Rizzo, Michael A Smirnov, Maria P Sokolova
pmc-11644167.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). 3D printing has become essential to many fields for its low-cost production and rapid prototyping abilities. As 3D printing becomes an alternative manufacturing tool, developing methods to non-destructively evaluate defects for quality control is essential. This study integrates the non-destructive terahertz (THz) analysis methods of terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) and terahertz computed tomography (THz CT) to image and assess 3D printed resin structures for defects.

pmc-11651653.title: Midbrain encodes sound detection behavior without auditory cortex
pmc-11651653.creator: Tai-Ying Lee, Yves Weissenberger, Andrew J King, Johannes C Dahmen, Brice Bathellier, Tai-Ying Lee, Yves Weissenberger, Andrew J King, Johannes C Dahmen
pmc-11651653.description: Hearing involves analyzing the physical attributes of sounds and integrating the results of this analysis with other sensory, cognitive, and motor variables in order to guide adaptive behavior. The auditory cortex is considered crucial for the integration of acoustic and contextual information and is thought to share the resulting representations with subcortical auditory structures via its vast descending projections.

pmc-12423136.title: Assessment of genomic prediction capabilities of transcriptome data in a barley multi-parent RIL population
pmc-12423136.creator: Christopher Arlt, Delphine van Inghelandt, Jinquan Li, Benjamin Stich
pmc-12423136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Key messageLow-cost and high-throughput RNA sequencing data for barley RILs achieved GP performance comparable to or better than traditional SNP array datasets when combined with parental whole-genome sequencing SNP data.AbstractThe field of genomic selection (GS) is advancing rapidly on many fronts including the utilization of multi-omics datasets with the goal of increasing prediction ability and becoming an integral part of an increasing number of breeding programs ensuring future food security.

pmc-12465637.title: Effects of whole-plant extracts of four species dominant in the Qinghai-Tibetan plateau on their germination and growth patterns
pmc-12465637.creator: Hui Li, Jianpeng Wang, Yumao Ning, Shree Prakash Pandey, Zhenqing Li, Yongjie Liu
pmc-12465637.description: Allelopathy plays an important role in driving plant interactions. Effects of allelopathy on seed germination and plant growth have been extensively investigated, while the impacts of whole-plant water extracts of different plants on their seed germination, and growth of shoots and roots are still unclear.

pmc-12542655.title: Evidence of ESBL plasmid transfer and selective persistence of multiple host-associated Escherichia coli isolates in a chicken cecal fermentation model
pmc-12542655.creator: J. Leng, M. Ferrandis-Vila, R. Oldenkamp, J. W. Mehat, A. S. Fivian-Hughes, S. Kumar Tiwari, B. Van der Putten, V. Trung Nguyen, A. Bethe, J. Clark, P. Singh, T. Semmler, S. Schwarz, J. Alvarez, N. T. Hoa, M. Bootsma, C. Menge, C. Berens, C. Schultsz, J. M. Ritchie, R. M. La Ragione
pmc-12542655.description: The guts of animals and humans harbor diverse microbial communities that are regularly exposed to bacteria originating from food, water, and their surroundings. Species such as Escherichia coli are adept at colonizing multiple hosts, along with surviving in the environment. By encoding pathogenic traits and transmissible forms of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), E. coli can also pose a zoonotic risk.

pmc-12700123.title: Malaria Trends, Burden, Seasonal Variation, and Interventions in Western Tigray, Ethiopia
pmc-12700123.creator: Getachew Belay Kassahun, Amanuel Mesele Berhe, Merhawi Alemu Brhanu, Brhane Berhe Aregawi, Priya Gusain
pmc-12700123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDespite being preventable and treatable, malaria continues to have a devastating impact on people’s health and livelihoods around the world. In Ethiopia, it is one of the three leading causes of hospital admission and mortality.

pmc-12805697.title: Endogenous green technology innovation and diffusion with strategic international spillovers
pmc-12805697.creator: Zhuo Feng
pmc-12805697.description: Escalating environmental challenges necessitate accelerated green technology innovation and diffusion. This paper introduces a novel theoretical framework synthesizing differential game theory, endogenous growth with directed technical change, and network analysis to investigate the interplay between strategic national R&D investments, the endogenous direction of innovation, and structured international knowledge spillovers.

pmc-13192026.title: Persistent pulmonary hypertension, neonatal stroke, coagulopathy and multi-organ failure due to severe enterovirus sepsis: two case reports
pmc-13192026.creator: Arangan Kirubakaran, Kirsty Gray, Thomas Slater, Zoe Cass-Tansey, Amna Alvi, Sundar Sathiyamurthy, Ujwal Kariholu
pmc-13192026.description: BackgroundDisseminated neonatal enteroviral infection is a rare and life-threatening condition with significant multi-organ involvement. It often presents with nonspecific symptoms that may be mistakenly attributed to bacterial infections. Prompt recognition and treatment are crucial to prevent rapid disease progression. We report two cases of disseminated neonatal enterovirus, including a novel instance of persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN) and neonatal stroke.

pmc-13226266.title: Chronotherapeutic administration of neoadjuvant chemotherapy reduces cancer-related fatigue-like behavior
pmc-13226266.creator: Claire O Kisamore, Caleb A Kisamore, Jayla M Boyd, Paul J Owolabi, Divya B Kadri, Alan D Mizener, Emidio E Pistilli, William H Walker
pmc-13226266.description: Circadian rhythms are ∼24-h oscillations in physiology and behavior and can be used to optimally time treatment, a practice known as chronotherapy. Chronotherapy for cancer treatment was first successfully utilized >50 years ago and has been demonstrated to improve anti-tumor efficacy and reduce toxic effects of chemotherapy. However, to our knowledge, no study has assessed chrono-chemotherapy for cancer-related fatigue (CRF).

pmc-13401564.title: Haptic illusion during finger-held disk rotation: revisiting a deceptively simple illusion
pmc-13401564.creator: Akira Imai, Patrice Revol, Yves Rossetti

pmc-13457912.title: A Retrospective Analysis of the Clinical Response and Safety of Radiofrequency Microneedling Treatment in Managing Acne Vulgaris
pmc-13457912.creator: Soyeon Lee, Hye One Kim, Song-Yi Baek, Narendra Kumar
pmc-13457912.description: BackgroundRadiofrequency (RF) microneedling is increasingly used for acne management; however, real-world evidence for its clinical effects and safety remains limited.ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to describe the clinical response and safety of POTENZA RF microneedling (RFMN) for acne vulgaris in routine practice.MethodsThe authors retrospectively analyzed data from adults treated at a tertiary dermatology center in Seoul, Republic of Korea.

pmc-13461687.title: Current practice, barriers and facilitators to caries management in children: a qualitative study in the Netherlands
pmc-13461687.creator: Catharina P M Elsenberg, Monique H van der Veen, Sten Jeuring, Marie Charlotte DNJM Huysmans, Linda Kwakkenbos
pmc-13461687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDental caries remains a global challenge and implementing preventive and minimally invasive treatments for primary teeth is difficult in everyday practice. Evidence on how these approaches are applied and perceived is limited.AimObjectives were to (1) describe the current practice in preventive and minimally invasive caries treatment for children; (2) evaluate their alignment with national guidelines; and (3) identify barriers and facilitators experienced by oral healthcare professionals (OHCPs) and parents in managing caries in Dutch children under 12 years.DesignSemi-structured interviews were conducted with

pmc-13549897.title: Starting from the future by looking to the past: reclaiming radical pedagogies, charting cartographies of imagination
pmc-13549897.creator: Nivethitha Ram Ganapathiram, Andy Guise
pmc-13549897.description: This perspective piece offers a theoretical and pedagogical framework for delivering meaningful social justice education in medical curricula, grounded in the design of an anti-discrimination pilot programme for undergraduate medical students. Drawing on John Dewey, Paulo Freire, and bell hooks, we examine three contemporary challenges—neoliberal pedagogies, technological determinism, and manufactured scarcity—and propose three entangled responses: relational community-building, conscientização, and vulnerability.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) AIS The term “AIS” means Automatic Identification System (as defined in section 164.46 of title 33, Code of Federal Regulations, or a similar successor regulation). (2) Combined Maritime Forces The term “Combined Maritime Forces” means the 33-nation naval partnership, originally.
